clone_steps: copy silo manifest and replace identity/surface fields only
copy data/_catalog-empty.template.json to the clone catalogue
copy public/mtg/index.html unchanged except data-silo slug
compile registry and fee policy from the same manifest
run CUBE clone verifier and Gauntlet
keep candidate hidden until explicit publish approval

accept_if: catalogue belongs only to clone slug
catalogue starts empty unless supply has independent evidence
generated shell matches MTG master except declared slug
checkout remains disabled without verified Stripe mapping, rights, settlement, fulfilment and delivery evidence

description: A Magic: The Gathering marketplace for real card listings and decks. Listings, checkout, and delivery remain evidence-gated.
